hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Plunger
function: The close-fit piston stroked by the rods, carrying the traveling valve at its bottom; the clearance to the barrel sets slippage.

tabs.overview: Metal plungers with grooves to trap sand, or soft-packed plungers; fit chosen for the fluid viscosity.
tabs.safety: Wear shows as falling pump efficiency.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
